jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Head of NAMER Partner Sales Strategy to serve as the strategic partner to the Director of NAMER Partner Sales. This role designs and evolves the Geo-level GTM execution framework across Deep, Focus, Scale, and Indirect partner engagement motions. You will operate at Geo scale across all NAMER divisions and partner development functions, anticipate organizational evolution, identify structural gaps before they create execution friction, and work with Partner & Field Sales Operations to operationalize strategic frameworks. This is a high-impact strategic position with influence across all partner sales divisions, AMER partner sales and development leadership, and field sales organizations. Key job responsibilities Operating Model Design & Evolution You will design and evolve the GTM framework that governs how NAMER partner sales operates. This includes coverage models, sales play architecture, inspection cadences, and the mechanisms that translate strategy into PSL execution. You will stress-test the operating model against organizational priorities, identify drift patterns, and propose structural changes when the model no longer serves NAMER's growth objectives. You will work with divisional Partner Sales Leaders to ensure clarity on role boundaries, inspection logic, and escalation thresholds. Your work here sets the standard for how partner sales operates across the Geo. Critical Inputs to NAMER Inspection Cadences You will generate the strategic analytics and performance signals that inform all NAMER inspection cadences, including WBR, IPMM, MBR, Top Deals, MFR, and Forecast. For each cadence, you will prepare decision-ready briefs that surface the information leadership needs to govern and make course corrections. You will work with Sales Operations to ensure cadence logistics run smoothly while maintaining focus on the business signals that matter. Your analytical work will enable faster, more rigorous leadership decision-making. About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Events team advances that mission by connecting the people building AI with the people using it to solve problems, create new things, and open up opportunities for others.

We bring developers, business leaders, customers, partners, and communities together to experience our technology firsthand and imagine what they can build with it. From global gatherings to hands-on experiences, our ambition is to inspire people to think bigger—and give them the ideas, relationships, and confidence to help shape what comes next.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Global Head of Events to lead a large, established global events and production team, with the opportunity to define what comes next.

Working with OpenAI’s executive team, you’ll set the direction for our event portfolio, focus investment on the experiences that matter most, and give the team the clarity and support to do its best work. This is a chance to build on a substantial foundation and create the experiences people will associate with OpenAI for years to come.

Your remit will span the company: flagship conferences, product launch experiences, developer gatherings, executive programs, regional events, and our presence at important industry and cultural moments. You’ll own the strategy, team, investments, and agency relationships that make that work possible. The team also leads in-house production for OpenAI’s town halls, webinar studio, and film projects.

You’ll bring creative judgment, business instincts, and a love of bringing people together. You’re entrepreneurial and deeply curious: ready to start with an open question, find a direction, and learn by making things. You can make good decisions with incomplete information, bring others along, and change course when you learn something new.

You’re also excited to use AI in your own work and help the team discover better ways to plan, create, and deliver experiences.

In this role, you will

- Set OpenAI’s global events strategy and focus investment on the experiences that matter most.

- Partner with executives on event priorities, programming, and participation in key moments.

- Create flagship gatherings and original formats that bring our products, ideas, and communities together.

- Work across Brand, Creative, Product, Research, and Communications to create thoughtful, cohesive attendee experiences.

- Lead and develop a global events and production team, while helping regional teams adapt experiences for their markets.

- Own budgets, agencies, vendors, and complex production in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.

- Oversee in-house production for town halls, webinars, and film projects.

- Partner with Revenue Marketing, Field Marketing, and developer teams on audience goals and follow-through; connect live, digital, and hybrid events to engagement beyond the room.

- Define success across product understanding, adoption, community, customer relationships, brand, and business results, using feedback and AI to improve future experiences.

You might thrive in this role if you

- 14+ years of experience in global events, experiential marketing, and large-scale production, including leadership of teams, budgets, and programs across multiple markets.

- A track record of creating distinctive flagship experiences and building the teams and processes to deliver them consistently.

- Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how to design experiences for developers, business leaders, customers, partners, and communities.

- Experience developing leaders, setting priorities across a broad portfolio, and guiding an established team through change.

- Experience leading complex live and recorded productions, managing agencies and significant budgets, and partnering with senior stakeholders.

- The ability to connect event investment to meaningful outcomes while keeping the attendee experience central.

- An entrepreneurial approach to ambiguity, curiosity about AI, and firsthand experience using it to improve your work.

Workplace & Location

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Occasional travel will be required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. The FDPM owns product outcomes inside a portfolio of enterprise accounts: earning deep trust with senior customer stakeholders, driving deployments to production, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to the platform team. The best FDPMs have shipped products into large organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

What You'll Do

• Own product outcomes for our highest impact enterprise accounts. You are the accountable PM for product delivery and customer value.
• Build trusted advisory relationships with VP/C-level buyers and senior technical leads. Become the reliable escalation point on the Scale side before issues surface externally.
• Drive deployments from contract to production. You have done this before for large organizations. You know what 'production-ready' actually means and you close the gap.
• Translate real customer workflows, friction, and priorities into high-signal product input for core platform teams. Not requirements docs — specific, evidence-backed product perspective with tradeoffs articulated.
• Distinguish where the product is the constraint from where execution, integration, or change management is. Drive each type of blocker to resolution through the right channel.
• Partner closely with FDEs so the account runs as a coordinated team, not a set of parallel workstreams.
• Identify and develop expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value
• Represent customer reality to platform and leadership with enough credibility that it changes decisions.

What We're Looking For

Core Competencies

• Enterprise deployment ownership: has driven AI/ML or complex software products from contract to production at scale, with real integration, real security constraints, real change management.
• Product judgment in the field: translates customer reality into product direction, not just feature requests; can say no credibly and explain why.
• Customer trust-building: earns and maintains trust with demanding senior stakeholders over multi-quarter engagements; manages conflict without eroding the relationship.
• Technical translation: bridges the gap between customer engineering teams and Scale platform engineers; does not relay messages, adds interpretation.
• Operating in ambiguity: creates structure where there is none; makes decisions with incomplete information; does not wait for fully defined requirements.
• Clear, precise communication: adjusts for audience (exec vs. engineer vs. PM); writes and speaks at the right level of detail; does not over-explain or under-explain.

Must-Have Qualifications

• 6+ years in product management, technical program management, or a customer-facing product ownership role.
• Demonstrated record of shipping products or platform capabilities into large organizations — not pilots or proofs-of-concept. You can name the customer, the scale, the integration, and what production actually looked like.
• Extreme ownership and follow-through: closes loops without reminders, drives outcomes across teams without formal authority, holds self and others to commitments.
• Comfortable operating with senior customer stakeholders (VP/C-level) and senior engineers simultaneously; credible presence in high-stakes rooms on both sides.
• Strong judgment under pressure: makes good calls quickly with incomplete information, knows when to escalate vs. resolve, does not generate thrash.
• Technical fluency sufficient to hold a real conversation with a platform engineer about architectural tradeoffs — not deep coding, but genuine comprehension of how systems work in production.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with AI/ML platform products — data labeling, RLHF, fine-tuning workflows, or model evaluation pipelines.
• Experience in a startup or early-stage environment where process didn't exist and had to be created.

About the Team

The DoorDash Air team is bringing drone delivery to reality. To make this happen, we’re building a strong electrical team to design high reliability, high power density converters, and fault-tolerant controls electronics. Come join us to build a new class of aircrafts and deploy at scale.

DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better.

About the Role

As the Product Manager Airspace & Autonomy for DoorDash Air’s Airspace and Autonomy capabilities, you will own the end-to-end product strategy for the software, services, autonomy, perception, human interfaces and related capabilities required to deploy autonomous drone delivery at scale.

You will connect DoorDash’s order and logistics platform with the aircraft, autonomy stack, mission-planning services, UTM capabilities, fleet-management tools, and operator workflows that execute each delivery. You will define how an order moves from merchant readiness through dispatch, airspace validation, autonomous flight, delivery, and completion within the broader DoorDash marketplace, ensuring that new features align to DoorDash Air’s roadmap across teams while balancing execution timelines against technical debt.

You will lead product direction across autonomy, aviation software, services, hardware, systems engineering, flight operations, UTM, safety, regulatory, data, and DoorDash platform teams. You will work closely with the Head of UTM and senior Engineering and Operations leaders to establish the product roadmap, clarify system boundaries, make build-versus-partner decisions, and align technical investment with operational scale and unit economics. You will also coach and mentor engineers to help them understand how their work contributes to the broader vision and enables safe and scalable drone delivery operations.

This is not a coordination-only role, nor is it purely an internally facing role. You will already have deep credibility in standards development organizations and will promote best practices to help ensure that DoorDash Air’s software, services and hardware meet technical standards required for regulatory compliance in the U.S. and abroad. You will set the vision, establish priorities, make informed technical and product tradeoffs, and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering an integrated drone delivery system.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own the end-to-end product strategy for DoorDash Air’s safety critical software, services and platform infrastructure. Define the long-term vision, platform architecture, capability roadmap, and investment priorities across aircraft, onboard software, cloud services, operational tooling, and DoorDash platform integrations.
• Integrate drone delivery into the DoorDash marketplace. Define how merchant preparation, order readiness, dispatch timing, routing, customer promises, delivery-zone eligibility, and fulfillment decisions interact with aircraft availability, weather, airspace, and operational constraints.
• Lead the autonomy product roadmap. Establish priorities across mission planning, autonomous path and motion planning, contingency behaviors, rerouting, detect-and-avoid integration, vehicle health, payload handling, landing and delivery behaviors, and remote assistance.
• Create the roadmap to progress from 1:1 to m:N operations. Define the incremental technical capabilities required to move from one operator supervising one aircraft toward increasingly autonomous multi-aircraft operations, including exception management, alert prioritization, task allocation, fleet orchestration, remote intervention, and human-autonomy interface design.
• Define the data strategy for autonomous aviation. Determine which geospatial, terrain, obstacle, weather, airspace, population-risk, connectivity, landing-zone, and operational data layers should be built internally, licensed, sourced through partners, or generated by the fleet.
• Build UTM and airspace-management capabilities. Lead product requirements for operational-volume generation, strategic and tactical deconfliction, dynamic rerouting, airspace authorization, constraint management, conformance monitoring, and interoperability with UTM service providers and public airspace systems.
• Lead standards compliance and engagement. Champion compliance with relevant standards — ASTM F3201 (software), F3548 and F3411 (UTM-specific functions) — across the airspace software roadmap and specs. Maintain an active leadership role in ASTM standards-development activities on behalf of DoorDash.
• Productize regulatory compliance. Translate Part 135 operating requirements, BVLOS approvals, safety cases, operational limitations, and emerging Part 108 concepts into reusable software, data, workflow, auditability, and configuration-management capabilities.
• Make build, buy, and partner decisions. Evaluate technology providers, data sources, autonomy components, and infrastructure partners based on strategic differentiation, integration complexity, operational risk, economics, and time to market.
• Define system-level success metrics. Work across the organization to establish instrumentation and KPIs across delivery success, order-to-dispatch time, route efficiency, intervention frequency, operator-to-aircraft ratio, aircraft utilization, mission completion, system availability, regulatory conformance, and cost per delivery.
• Connect technical investment to business outcomes. Develop business cases and sequencing recommendations that balance safety, customer experience, operational scalability, engineering effort, deployment speed, and long-term unit economics.
• Shape the technical organization. Identify the product, systems, autonomy, platform, data, hardware, test, and operational capabilities required to achieve the roadmap. Partner with functional leaders to define roles, close talent gaps, and build an organization capable of scaling beyond individual experts.

We’re excited about you because…

• 10+ years of product management, technical product leadership, systems leadership, or related experience, including significant responsibility for complex software or cyber-physical platforms.
• 5+ years of experience in autonomous systems, robotics, UAS, aviation technology, safety-critical systems, or another highly regulated real-world operating environment.
• A demonstrated track record of taking technically complex products from early concept or prototype through validation, deployment, and operational scale.
• Experience owning products that span multiple layers of a technology stack, including embedded or vehicle software, cloud services, APIs, data infrastructure, operational applications, and hardware integration.
• Strong technical fluency across autonomous-system concepts such as mission planning, path planning, motion planning, perception, localization, guidance and control, behavior management, contingency handling, simulation, telemetry, and command and control.
• Experience defining product strategy and architecture for distributed, real-time, or mission-critical systems in which reliability, safety, and operational performance are fundamental product requirements.
• Working knowledge of UTM, airspace-management systems, geospatial data, flight-planning services, operational volumes, conformance monitoring, and airspace interoperability.
• Experience operating within or building technology for FAA-regulated environments, including familiarity with any combination of National Airspace System hardware/software/procedures, Part 107, Part 135, Part 108, Part 146, BVLOS operating approvals, UTM or USS services, and evolving autonomous-flight regulations.
• Experience designing or scaling human-supervised autonomy, remote operations, multi-vehicle systems, fleet orchestration, or m:N operating models.

• Translates customer needs into effective product designs and customer-driven innovation strategies.
• Develop and optimize formulations that deliver differentiated performance, stability, and consumer-relevant benefits aligned with brand strategy.

• Conduct patent searches to monitor competitive innovations and generate intellectual property in own area of development in the form of patents, formulation know-how, and trade secrets.
